en: The Triplet of the Wholesome; The Triplet of What is Fixed in the Wrongness.

Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor fixed in the wrongness [of error], a state that is unwholesome and fixed in the wrongness arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Conditioned by a state that is neither wholesome nor fixed in the rightness [of enlightenment], a state that is wholesome and fixed in the rightness arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and indeterminate, an indeterminate and indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. There are five under root, five under predominance … pe … five under non-disappearance.
